title: Ensure system wide crypto policy disables macs less than 128 bits
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 1.6.4: Ensure system wide crypto policy disables macs less than 128 bits

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

steps.name: Check if the system-wide crypto policy state file exists
steps.function: 1. Check if the system-wide crypto policy state file exists using command: `test -f /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol`. Expected result: exit code 0 (file exists).

steps.name: Check that no MAC algorithms with less than 128 bits are enabled in the system-wide crypto policy
steps.function: 2. Check that no MAC algorithms with less than 128 bits are enabled in the system-wide crypto policy using command: `grep -Pi -- '^\h*mac\h*=\h*([^#\n\r]+)?-64\b' /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol`. Expected result: no output (nothing returned).

steps.function: 3. Check overall compliance status: PASS if the policy file exists and the grep command returns no output; SKIP if the policy file does not exist; FAIL if the policy file exists but the grep command returns any output.

steps.function: 4. Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) derived from the last requirement's status variable.

reference_procedure:
Run the following script to verify weak MACs are disabled:
# grep -Pi -- '^\h*mac\h*=\h*([^#\n\r]+)?-64\b' /etc/crypto-policies/state/CURRENT.pol
